sentences.en: I plan to extol your virtues to all who will listen.
sentences.zh: 我打算向所有愿意倾听的人赞美你的优点。

sentences.en: The teacher extols the importance of reading every day.
sentences.zh: 老师赞颂每天阅读的重要性。

sentences.en: Many people extol the beauty of nature in their writings.
sentences.zh: 很多人在他们的作品中颂扬大自然的美丽。
